title: Among the superheroes with blue eyes, how many of them have the super power
question:
Among the superheroes with blue eyes, how many of them have the super power of "Agility"?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: blue eyes refers to colour = 'Blue' and eye_colour_id = colour.id; super power of "Agility" refers to power_name = 'Agility'

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON s.XCL_023 = c.XCL_005
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.XCL_013 = sp.XCL_030
WHERE c.XCL_006 = 'Blue'
  AND sp.XCL_031 = 'Agility'
